 Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds To Miss Rest Of Season With Shoulder Injury
 By Connor Byrne |
 at October 23, 2026 3:08 pm 
 In yet another major blow to the Giants, linebacker Tremaine Edmunds will miss the rest of the season with a shoulder injury, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports. He joins quarterback Jaxson Dart and pass rusher Brian Burns as key Giants who will not return from injuries this season.
 Edmunds was a big-ticket offseason signing for the Giants, who brought him in on a three-year, $36MM contract after the Bears released him. While playing all 380 of the Giants’ defensive snaps over their first six games, the 27-year-old piled up 50 tackles (three for loss) and added three quarterback hits, two sacks and a pair of pass breakups. The ninth-year veteran and two-time Pro Bowler has never finished with fewer than 100 tackles in a season, but that streak will come to an end in 2026.
 More to come….
